card.name: Counting words before waves, portions, doses
card.fires_on: Number or order words (two, three, second, third, next, 4) that come right before a countable unit such as waves, portions, phases, doses or events.

modes.label: Number before portions or waves
modes.description: A count word that says how many parts something is split into.
modes.example: Add 34 mL of water in<< two>> portions.

modes.label: Ordinal before phase or event
modes.description: Words like second, third or next that place an item in a sequence.

modes.description: A digit giving how many doses a regimen lasts.

card.plain: It notices a number or order word that is about to be followed by a count of parts, steps or doses.
